notes: §2002:15.12.3 RV4 'When argument-1 does not occupy an integral number of bytes, the returned value is rounded to the next larger integer value'; a level-1 elementary bit item gets no trailing filler (§2002:8.5.1.5.3 NOTE 'No filler is generated ... at the end of a level 1 elementary item'), so PIC 1(12) BIT is 12 bits -> BIT12=2, PIC 1(5) BIT -> BIT5=1, and the integral control PIC 1(8) BIT -> BIT8=1. Run at --std 2002 with the pinned build dc1f2dcce8: output equals the derivation.
